newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas Advertising aims to double profits.
newsitem.headline: Havas Advertising aims to double profits.

text.p: Havas Advertising managing director Alain de Pouzilhac said on Friday that he aimed to eliminate the group's debt by 1999 and double its profits.
"It's a question now of getting rid of our debt. Our objective is to do that within three years via the convertible bonds," he said in an interview with the newspaper Figaro.
"In 1999, I think we'll exceed five billion francs of gross margin, double our profits and be free of debt," he said.
Havas Advertising, part of Havas, reported net attributable profit of 151.5 million francs in 1995, up 11 percent, a gross margin of four billion and debt of 895 million.
